text:
kai: FYI alert: ingestion found ~4.3k unmapped GCP lines yesterday => ~$12.6k unallocated GPU spend, mainly nvidia-t4 variants.

ana: link?

kai: https://dash.internal/alerts/ALRT-7221. Export shows SKU changed to 'nvidia-t4-eu' so our tagger missed.

billing-bot: ingest job billing.ingest_gcp_export v3.9 flagged 4312 unmapped rows for 2026-04-02.

zach: Which customers? urgent if invoices close tomorrow.

kai: Mostly internal playground (~9.1k) + three SMBs total ~1.5k. No invoices sent yet for affected SMBs.

cloudops-ryan: GCP rolled region suffixes in eu-west. Quick mitigation: add regex map /nvidia-t4(-.*)?/ -> canonical t4 in parser and deploy shim on export.

ana: Can we dry-run reprocess first? want delta report.

kai: Yes — dry-run on billing-sandbox, publish /reports/reproc_20260402_unmapped.csv. Estimated 10m.

cloudops-ryan: Deploying export-lambda shim to eu-west now, will add metric export.sku_normalized.

billing-bot: Reminder: reprocess with apply_adjustments=true will increment invoice versions; accounting approval required.

(12m later)

kai: Dry-run finished. Customer-facing delta ~1,535.55. Uploaded report and created ticket FIN-4972.

zach: Finance approves reprocess before invoices. Proceed.

ana: PR merged (billing-parser #512) mapping rule + unit tests.

cloudops-ryan: Shim live, metric in place. Monitoring.

kai: Starting reprocess run_id=reproc_20260402_gcp_sku_map, apply_adjustments=true. ETA 30m.

billing-bot: Reprocess started — will publish delta to /reports/reproc_20260402_delta.csv when complete.

(35m later)

kai: Reprocess complete. Total re-attributed $12,649.67, customer-facing delta $1,535.55. FIN-4972 updated.

zach: Approved. Notify customers and bump invoice versions. Good catch.

ana: Will write short postmortem in #postmortems and recommend permanent parser tests and export-contract checks.

kai: Setting 48h watch on export.sku_normalized metric; escalate to provider eng if >0 after 3 exports.
